color.$description: Onyx theme-private palette. Resolved at build time and never emitted as CSS custom properties. Surfaces are warm graphite, not black; text is warm ivory, not pure white; the metal is champagne gold, never a saturated yellow.

graphite.$description: Layered warm graphite surfaces. The darkest step is a soft charcoal, deliberately lighter than a pure-black page; borders are one step lighter than the surface they sit on.

ivory.$description: Warm text colors. Never pure white.

gold.$description: Champagne gold. The 500 step is the solid interactive fill; 300 is the brighter text-on-tint variant used on translucent gold surfaces.

rose.$description: Muted rose: destructive actions and error text. The 600 step is the solid destructive fill, 300 the text-on-tint variant.

jade.$description: Soft jade: success and completion states. The 300 step is the text-on-tint variant.

amber.$description: Soft amber: warnings and pending states. The 300 step is the text-on-tint variant.

steel.$description: Desaturated steel blue: informational roles. The 600 step is the solid informational fill.
